description: This file defines the class 'S3EncryptionMultipartUploader' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling multipart encrypted uploads to S3. It extends the MultipartUploader class and includes traits for encryption, cipher building, and user agent management. The class manages encrypted multipart uploads, offering methods to configure and initiate such uploads, and supports different encryption strategies and parameters.

classes.name: S3EncryptionMultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart encrypted uploads to Amazon S3, supporting encryption configurations, and upload state management.

methods.description: Prepares the data source for encryption, deferring work until the upload promise executes.
